[size=18][b]VFM End Game[/b][/size]
• [b]Exchange no-shows & unfinished business:[/b] Every exchange involves a few missed connections. Please use GeekMail and/or text messages to make alternative arrangements during the convention, most missed connections are completed during the weekend. Send me a [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekmail/compose?touser=StormbringerGrey][b]GeekMail[/b][/url] with the transaction details if the buyer or seller remains unresponsive by the close of the convention.
• [b]Update your BGG sales information:[/b] Sometime next week I will be sending BGG a list of sold items that were not properly recorded for the purpose of advertising fees, please don't be on that list. If you are not certain, both [url=https://www.yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/334270?Status=IncompleteSale&Sort=Seller][b]Alpha 1[/b][/url] and [url=https://bgg.activityclub.org/tools/vfm.html?listid=334270#solditemsunmarked][b]Alpha 2[/b][/url] can list sold items that have not been properly recorded.
• [b]Pay your ad fees:[/b] The August 3rd invoice from BGG will be the invoice that should be paid for this VFM, as stated above, please update your sales information so that you are charged the correct amount.
⚠️ Use of this GeekList as a seller, buyer, or in any other capacity constitutes an agreement to abide by all instructions on this page as well as all instructions and terms of service located [thread=3272985][b]here.[/b][/thread].

How exactly does the posting tool work? After I click "load" what happens? Will I then use "edit" to add prices and condition, or will it ask those questions before it posts to the VFM? Thanks in advance.

I tried using the posting tool on my phone but it didn’t work for me. I would load and nothing happened, so I posted my games individually.

[q="larrydurbin"]How exactly does the posting tool work? After I click "load" what happens? Will I then use "edit" to add prices and condition, or will it ask those questions before it posts to the VFM? Thanks in advance. [/q] When you hit load you will get a list of the games in your collection marked "for trade" (if you don't have any games marked for trade, the list will be empty). To the right of each game is a form; set the game condition, selling terms (auction, BIN, both), starting bid and/or BIN price, and click "Add Item", you will be transferred to BGG with the posting box pre-filled and formatted but you must still click "add item" to add your game to the list. The tool is particularly helpful when selling games with expansions as the tool will optionally include them with the base game, doing this manually requires a lot of back-and-forth in BGG to look up and link the expansion pictures. Note: occasionally your trade collection may fail to load under periods of heavy usage, in this case an error is shown and you must simply wait try again later.

Hey Folks, I am seeing a lot of auctions without end dates. Please be advised that starting this year, ALL VFM GeekList transactions must be concluded on or before midnight July 2nd, that includes auctions, that said, auctions are still required to explicitly state an end condition even if it's as vague as "when I feel like it". Bidders are entitled to know how long their money will be obligated [u]before[/u] bidding.

For attendees apparently, only the Dice Tower Flea market is still on. An email got sent out to those registered on Apr 5th.
Quote from the email [i]"This year, we will not be doing an attendee flea market. This was a difficult decision to make, but ultimately by not doing this we are able to grow the Virtual Flea Market (see more below!), Dice Tower Flea Market, and bring events to Dice Tower East."[/i]

A couple interesting thoughts that the vfm always brings out for me...
1. It's incredible how many games come and go over the years, and how quickly we forget some games that were once "what everyone was playing and talking about."
2. Conversely, there are so many great games on here for those newer to gaming. You can really craft an awesome collection if you want to at a good price on here.
Anyhow, happy selling and buying everyone! 😎

Hey everyone, please try to move policy discussions and/or behind-the-scenes comments to the [thread=3272985][b]admin page[/b][/thread] and reserve this small space for comments helpful to the operation of the VFM. In that spirit, here's a user tip:
If you sell an item and you want to put the buyer in the item description (highly recommended), edit the description and insert the following code: [code][user=username][/user][/code]
If you want a condensed version without the profile picture, use [code][user=username]username[/user][/code]. The condensed version is sometimes preferable if you are selling a bunch of promos under one item entry and need to list many buyers.
This weekend I will be putting together a post for the FaceBook group of tips and tricks for new users, I will repost here.

There has been one addition and one clarification to the ToS bullet points. As usual, please keep comments on the [thread=3272985]admin thread[/thread].
[q]• [Buyers] ⚠️Please do not make negative comments on prices, there are many sources for comparison pricing including the Alpha tools, buyers are responsible for doing due diligence. Comments such as "That is higher than I'd like to go, would you consider $X" is acceptable but "I can buy that for less on Amazon, would you consider $X" is not. If you feel an item is misrepresented try to clarify with seller via GeekMail, contact [geekurl=/geekmail/compose?touser=StormbringerGrey]VFM Admin[/geekurl] as a last resort. • [Buyers and Sellers] ⚠️A binding offer on the VFM trumps unposted private negotiations. Back-channel negotiations via GeekMail or on the Wish List are discouraged but not prohibited, however, indicate the item is temporarily unavailable while the negotiations are on-going. The VFM depends on comment posting order to resolve priority, GeekMail, posts on the Wish List, and other forms of private communication should not be considered[/q]

Hey Folks, we have 119 items sold on the VFM that [b]ARE NOT[/b] properly marked as sold using the BGG sold button. This is my second post on this topic and many of the sellers that were out of compliance at the time of the first post are still out of compliance now. We are allowing an exception for trades and giveaways only, all other sold items must be marked. Per BGG admin, commission invoices do not have to be paid until after the event giving everyone plenty of time to make corrections if a buyer is a no-show (which is very rare anyway). Fear that a buyer might be a no-show [b]IS NOT[/b] an excuse to delay marking an item as sold. Not marking an item as sold will have the following negative consequences:
1. You will get a stern GeekMail from me asking you to fix the problem. 2. Items not properly marked as sold prior to June 1 will not be counted when allocating table space for the exchange 3. Items not properly marked as sold after June 30 will be submitted to BGG admin for manual commission collection, be aware that BGG may take further action as failure to properly identify items sold on a GeekList is a violation of [u]their[/u] terms of service.

Hi All, It has been brought to my attention that the ToS do not mention anything about time zones. This is relevant because auction end times are assumed to be in the convention time zone (EDT) which may not be the seller's time zone and is not the BGG default time zone (CDT). Sellers, if your published auction end time is not EDT, please update your listing to express the end time in EDT and bring the adjustment to the attention of your bidders. Just FYI, all users can update BGG to either their own time zone and/or the convention time zone [geekurl=/geekaccount.php?action=editforumsettings][b]here[/b][/geekurl]. The ToS will be updated shortly.

This is especially important for people placing bids from Nepal which is 9 hours and 45 minutes ahead of EST, which results in the Indian joke that Nepalis are always 15 minutes late for appointments. 🕘

[q="constancy"][q="StormbringerGrey"][q="Snowraven67"]We are in the midst of a family emergency and can no longer attend the Con. How do I cancel a sale on the VFM? I already notified the buyer. [/q] Navigate to your item, click the Sold for $XX.XX button, click the Sale ID number on the next screen, on the screen after that you should see a red cancel button. Note that there may be a bug, some people have reported not seeing the cancel button on that final screen.[/q] So if the cancel button isn't there, as it isn't for me, how do I clear the sale that's not happening?[/q] A sale cannot be canceled if the ad fee is paid, however, there is a confirmed bug that has been submitted to BGG admin where the cancel button does not appear on the Sale ID number page when it should. If you fall into this category, please send me a screen shot of that page along with your browser and platform details (ie: Safari on iOS, Chrome on Android, Edge on Windows, etc...), I will forward to BGG admin. In the meantime, if you have an alternate browser and/or platform, please try that and success or fail, please include the results with your submission

[q="pfmfurlong"]One of my sold items is listed as an incomplete sale on Alpha 1 because I didn't list the buyer. In other words, I think I am "on the list" of sales that were not properly recorded. In this case, I didn't list the buyer, but I no longer seem able to edit the listing. Does anyone know what I need to do on this?[/q] The VFM tool highlights your entry if the buyer is missing or if the sale isn’t recorded properly on BGG. For this VFM, you are only required to record the sale. Tagging the buyer is optional, but helpful for buyers and for statistical purposes.

item.comment: How does this version vary from the original? What year is this version published?

It's more of a travel version. The active player rolls a die and thinks of a word that starts with that letter. The other players try to match that word as best they can. It was published in 2009. Here is a link to the exact version and a couple of pictures although one is out of focus. https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/78436/apples-to-apples-mod [imageid=8144703] [imageid=8144704]
Thanks for your response. I don't think this version will meet the need.

Hey James, this isn't an auction listing.
The terminology for an auction is SB/starting bid.
BIN means buy it now.
FP means firm price.
If you mean to make an offer on any type of listing just write "Offer" and the price you wish to buy it for.
I don't want you to have a negative surprise when you find your bid has been ignored on a non-auction listing.
😉
If you do 20$, you will have a deal.

I'll give you $15[/q] The Scythe: Modular Board expansion allows you to change the landscape of Eastern Europa every time you play Scythe thanks to its double-sided game board and four large double-sided landscape tiles. Faction locations, i.e., the home base tiles, change each time you play.
The modular board adds a drafting element to set-up, along with a variant for a tighter map at lower player counts.
Featured Components
• 1 double-sided board (624x818mm, same size as the standard Scythe board) • 4 double-sided tiles (7 hexes per tile) • 8 home base tiles • 8 structure bonus tiles • 1 rulebook (11 languages) • Automa rules for solo play

item.comment: I am very interested! Let’s make a deal!
Sure, it's all yours! See you at the con :)
Wait I'm confused? I didn't BIN this, I was interested in making a deal. I don't want to pay $85. I was hoping to know what it came with and if you'd reduce the price!
Ah, I see! I'll unmark it for now! This is the Kickstarter version of the game. Let me know if you want any more details!

Well the game has already been unwrapped and played so I was hoping to get it cheaper than $85. Right now I can back the reprint of the game for $85 brand new. I’m assuming it’s just the base game with no extras. Could you go down in price? I don’t want to pay full price for a used copy.

Hey Jeremy, I am willing to negotiate a little on the price for this one. It's in excellent condition - we punched everything, then only ever played two games with it. I'm afraid it was just too "cozy" and not enough "crunchy" for our game group's preference! I would do $75.
If I'm being honest I'm coming in around $40
Realized that I forgot to mention that this includes the project backer stretch goals and one expansion. Description has been updated accordingly, and I'm dropping price down only to $70.

[q="Apj8240"]Realized that I forgot to mention that this includes the project backer stretch goals and one expansion. Description has been updated accordingly, and I'm dropping price down only to $70.[/q]
I'm still interested but I usually try to buy used games at around 50% of their retail value. That's why Im sitting at $40. I can maybe go up a little but I still think $70 is really high for this game.

[q="Apj8240"]Hey Jeremy, I am willing to negotiate a little on the price for this one. It's in excellent condition - we punched everything, then only ever played two games with it. I'm afraid it was just too "cozy" and not enough "crunchy" for our game group's preference! I would do $75.[/q] Yeah I've hear many people saying the same thing. I like cozy but I'm taking a risk since I have heard many people haven't enjoyed it. The convention is coming up soon. If you really don't enjoy the game sell it to me! My final price is $50. Let me know cause I am still interested. But I can't go higher than that since I have already spent so much.

Hi Jeremy, I appreciate the offer, and if it was up to just me, I would come down in price. But this Kickstarter was backed by my husband, and he's not willing to drop the price lower, I'm afraid. I hope you find a copy to try out, and I hope I can come down in price by next year if we still have it on our shelves!

On the box lid does the primary character on the right have large sun glasses on or does it look like the image above? Supposedly that character bore a resemblance to Suddam so they later changed it and put glasses over the face.
Yes, the English first edition looks like the image shown in the listing.
Sweet, if the box is in decent condition I'll BIN for $25.00

Mine has seen significant wear and tear with loads of tape, so a replacement would be nice. Along with a spare set of parts seems like a deal to me.
Yeah, this box should be good for you. My Axis & Allies game has two sets in it, so I understand. I'll mark this as sold when I get home later.

SOLD TO: [user=raisuki][/user]
Only selling cause I just got the Deluxe version!
I thought it was confusing what the different versions were, so this is what I found out:
Kickstarter limited edition: include base game + kickstarter promos (some deep and event cards).
Kickstarter Deluxe edition: include base game + kickstarter promos (some deep and event cards) + acrylic fish + foodbags + card sleeves.
Retail: include just the base game without the previous additions (it's not yet available).
retail version supports only 4 players, in contrast both Kickstarter versions includes a 5-6 expansion.

item.comment: Hi Debbie, would you be willing to sell the 5-player expansion and KS exclusive box separately?

Debbie- If this includes all the items from each of the links (like metal coins and 3d map from the box) and it doesn't have significant warping and/or alignment issues, I'll take it for $85.
Scott
I took the board out and assembled, looks good, had stored with several desiccant packs, and I do have metal coins. [imageid=8185947]

Thank you Debbie for taking the time to check and post a picture. Re warping: the initial KS had a production wheel that was "flimsy and the spokes warped and did not function well moving pieces between the spokes. After that came to light, the publisher revised the wheel to something more substantial." Do you know if your copy has wheel issues? Sorry to be a pest, but this was such an issue for some that they declared its significant impact on gameplay. If the wheels are good, I'm good.
Scott
No worries, questions are welcome 🙂 They corrected the wheel. I don't remember if it was with the expansion or a mail out after the kickstarter, but the wheels I have do not have any issues.

As there are 90 different Power cards available, it will open up a multitude of new strategies and adds even more replayability to the game!

Time to feed the raccoons and go for a run. Congrats Ken!
@gankatron I need to know more about/see the raccoons!
I'll PM you a video of Momma raccoon.

[q="ozmo"]@gankatron I need to know more about/see the raccoons![/q]
I couldn't figure out how to attach a video in Geekmail, so I just created a cloud storage link: [url=https://secure.eu.internxt.com/d/sh/file/6c29fd25-47f9-48ef-bd5e-cd4eebb37923/5636d8c627683588adc582b584ba6bb2e183f1ef51bdb3d6e3e5960d90c6766f]Friendly momma raccoon.[/url]
It gets hot here so we ice-cool a water bath for her. It is part of my retirement chores.
That’s great! Our local raccoons like the food but they’re more cautious. We have a huge one across the canal that will just stand and stare at us.

[q="ozmo"]That’s great! Our local raccoons like the food but they’re more cautious. We have a huge one across the canal that will just stand and stare at us. [/q]
They are extremely inquisitive and social. I feel the only reason they weren't domesticated is they didn't provide a significant function for the tribe, unlike dogs and cats.
I love those little guys. They just need to feel safe and their individual personalities will begin to show.
I will be working in the yard or garage and I'll feel a tug on my pants leg and they tell me they want treats, so silly.
Here is a picture from this morning illustrating how tiring it is to be a raccoon momma.
[url=https://share.eu.internxt.com/d/sh/file/55b35f51-a48f-483c-8739-05bf6f70a362/6d19ab1073768f6139e480020681ee53f4bc7ed6be7ad7c29299c2c26d40830e]Just hanging out in the heat[/url]

For sale are 4 solid skulls ... selling individually ... I want to keep 1, but don't care which ... so all 4 are listed, but only 3 are for sale. In the pics these are sitting on a AAA battery, just to show scale.
These make great 1st player markers, whether for pirate or halloween or ... whatever themed.
What are these? I do a fair bit of 3d printing and save my scraps, brims, failed prints, etc. They get cut up and then melted down (with a cheap toaster oven from goodwill) inside silicon molds. Add chips, melt, add chips, melt, ... over and over again. It takes a remarkable amount of plastic and time to make even the small ones.
Small ones: $5 Big ones: $10
Skull #1 (Grey, large, $10) [imageid=8217080][imageid=8217081]
Skull #2 (Black/green, small, $5) [imageid=8217082][imageid=8217083]
Skull #3 (White, small, $5) [imageid=8217084][imageid=8217085]
Skull #4 (Black/green, large, $10) [imageid=8217086][imageid=8217087]
[size=10] Paypal, venmo or cash. No zelle. If you have any questions or need pics, feel free to ask. It may take me a couple of days to get pictures, depending on my work/travel schedule.
[b]Times[/b] I'm scheduled for at least 1 more in-person game sales prior to the VFM. Any offers, including BINs, made within 48 hours (either direction) of June 15 should be considered non-binding until I can confirm the game is still available. Sales/Auctions will officially end June 19th. Feel free to make later offers, but no promises. [b]Deals[/b] Unlikely to accept any lower offers prior to June 1. [b]Trades[/b] I'm at least as interested in trades as in selling and willing to talk combos in various directions. Top of my wishlist: Orleans + deluxe bits, Wonderland's War, Nokosu Dice, Quebec [/size]

Withdrawn (fwiw, I've added this as part of a new entry for it + Auztralia, sold together) [-] 3D printed insert for Auztralia Trade only.
This is mostly the insert from [url=https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3392207]https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3392207[/url], except that I didn't like having different boxes for each resource (especially since they weren't filleted/scoopable) so I printed my own unified resource box. I really liked the insert set, but it only supports the base game, and so I had to print another one once I picked up the expansion. I didn't make it in order to sell it, but even so given that it is licensed under a non-commercial license, I'd rather just trade this out than try to get any money for it.
Check my bgg wishlist for trade options ... offers welcome. [/-]

I THINK it is the Complete Hero Variant Pack [thing=195338][/thing] since the square box looks similar, PLUS some of the original variant cards added to it as well. That would explain why there are 2 copies with different art of so many of the cards. The cube box is damaged in one corner.
That said, I've spent the last few hours itemizing this thing out, so here's what I see. Not really sure what this is worth ... so, let's say a [b]starting bid of $5? [/b] or [b] FREE if you purchase $50 or more from other listings (one sweetener per $50)[/b] [If anybody can help me value this, I'd welcome a comment or geekmail]

item.comment: I would offer $25. $40 is MSRP and you say it is only in Very Good condition. MSRP seems high for a fairly worn game--even with the promos.

$40 MSRP doesn't include the component upgrades add-on (the amazing looking dice and holders for the dice and cards. The BGG scale for condition anything higher than "Very Good" implies that the components were used (albeit only used 3 times). The component and the box are in perfect condition and the rulebook has no creases bends or folds, but the game has been played so I can't use "New" or "Like New". [q=https://boardgamegeek.com/wiki/page/Condition_of_a_game][b]New[/b] - A brand new unused, unopened, and undamaged game in perfect condition. The original packaging and all materials are in brand new condition. [b]Like New[/b] - Game just removed from shrink wrap. No wear and tear, all facets of the game are intact. [b]Very Good[/b] - Very minimal wear and tear. All game materials are present. You would give this item to a friend as a gift.[/q]

item.comment: I did not get the notification of your counter response and looks like I was beat out to accepting the offer.

[q="Sar2229"]I did see get the notification of your counter response and looks like I was beat out to accepting the offer. [/q] Nope I’m still waiting if you will take my counter offer. If not I’ll sell to Larry

Just so you understand, that's not how it works. I was first to respond , therefore the game belongs to me. However , I'm willing to be nice and step aside. If you wanted this game sar229 , you should have paid Jeremy $40 , which is a great deal. I hope thus is a lesson learned.

[q="larrydurbin"]Just so you understand, that's not how it works. I was first to respond , therefore the game belongs to me. However , I'm willing to be nice and step aside. If you wanted this game sar229 , you should have paid Jeremy $40 , which is a great deal. I hope thus is a lesson learned.[/q]
I don't think that's how it works. Jeremy promised it at $35 to someone else. Reminds me of my favorite scene in Finding Nemo. LOL.
[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/proxy/5OeZmgL-zCQdd3w8K60F0N05yYxd_5rxdV6rHwgEgbSB4cfo3GuTvicpgxQW3RIBcvS-o5pm8QbB2f2CORACXuHJK5yvZeBXyGD8EgIeTG7DiRu9deN0fe3v_rr0BOO_RMtzS2E-HMJphdJcP8pKdr5ymq9bvz0[/img]

They offered me $32 and I responded to their specific offer for $35. When you came in and offered $35 I wanted to respectfully wait for their reply since the offer was made to them specifically for the same price you offered. If you had said $36 I would have said yes. Just cause it’s the same price I was asking the other person. But yes it’s a great deal!

I would do $35 too but really do want to respect the process so I’m ok with Larry having it as well. I’m not sure how it is supposed to work since this is my first time and can honestly see both ways being ok.

To my knowledge from reading the FAQ, a deal is only binding if someone offers BIN, or both parties mutually agree to a lower value deal. Semantics are at play to some degree but the $35 deal was a haggled compromise between the seller and @sar229. Just because someone else says that they would take that deal before you @sar229, doesn’t mean it’s mutually agreed upon by the seller. Now if they hopped in and said BIN, you’d be out of luck. Arguably, since nothing has been officially agreed upon, if I came in with BIN, it could possibly be mine! However, I don’t want to stoke the fire anymore than I already have lol.
Pay your $35 Sar and enjoy your game.

[q="larrydurbin"]Just so you understand, that's not how it works. I was first to respond , therefore the game belongs to me. However , I'm willing to be nice and step aside. If you wanted this game sar229 , you should have paid Jeremy $40 , which is a great deal. I hope thus is a lesson learned.[/q]
That’s not how it works, the counter offer was offered to 1 person, but if that counter is declined then another may step in and ask for the same counter, but the original price still stands until the seller agrees to sell it below asking. You trying to claim the counter offer is more of a “in case the counter isn’t accepted, I’ll take it.”

Not sure why there is such a big discussion about it. I offered the game to Sir for $35 and waited for the response. If they said no it would go to Larry for that price. Sold to Sar. Sorry for any confusion or frustration!
It was a big deal because by offering to accept $35 you effectively lowered your BIN price to $35 and then did not honor that BIN price.
Thank you Richard. That's exactly the way I saw it.

[q="larrydurbin"]Thank you Richard. That's exactly the way I saw it.[/q]
Probably an official rule in the faq is in order. Would you do this in a live flea market? Jumping in the middle of a deal when the two people were present? It would be quite rude.

[q="bingle"]It was a big deal because by offering to accept $35 you effectively lowered your BIN price to $35 and then did not honor that BIN price.[/q] This happened to me already. I made an offer to someone for a game and they didn’t respond to me for a whole month. They said yes to my offer and so when I went to BIN it someone else swooped in and took it for that price. It wasn’t fair to me that they didn’t respond to my offer for a whole month and then sold the game to another person who offered the same price. I refused to do the same thing to someone else. Even if that’s “the way it works”. I was making a deal with one person because I quoted them in my offer. The game is sold so let’s please move on. People keep adding fuel to the fire with their opinions. This is a flea market, not a social media post to argue over. I feel we are being really rude to one another. It’s not about who’s right. Let’s leave it and just be at peace if that’s ok. Sar offered the game to Larry and Larry said buy your game and be happy. Sar has been trying to be really nice about it. It’s there first time doing one of these and we aren’t setting a good example for them.

[q="larrydurbin"]And again, you are incorrect. [/q]
Dude, why? The issue is resolved, and most of us agree with him, I would think, because that's the nice way to have transactions on here. If there is a specific offer to someone, that person gets first dibs until declined. You were 2nd. The official price had not been reduced, yet, because the post had not been edited with the new price.

There is not a specific order. You are mistaken. This was not a bid item. This item was listed at BIN. When that BIN is dropped to someone, it is dropped for everyone. The first person to meet that new dropped BIN gets the game. If this item were listed as a bid item , with a starting bid AND a BIN , that would be a different situation. Making up rules as you go , confuses everyone. To be clear , I'm very happy it worked out for Sar. I hope he enjoys the game. What we don't need are people stoking embers of a fire , long burned out. It was simply a breach of etiquette. Now , let's all put away our swords , put on a smile , and have a great convention!

The listing wasn't changed. It was a message to a specific person. At the point of an offer going to 1 person, the etiquette is to allow the person time to respond. It baffles me that you disagree, but you're obviously not changing your mind, so have a good one.

[q="larrydurbin"]There is not a specific order. You are mistaken. This was not a bid item. This item was listed at BIN. When that BIN is dropped to someone, it is dropped for everyone. The first person to meet that new dropped BIN gets the game. If this item were listed as a bid item , with a starting bid AND a BIN , that would be a different situation. Making up rules as you go , confuses everyone. To be clear , I'm very happy it worked out for Sar. I hope he enjoys the game. What we don't need are people stoking embers of a fire , long burned out. It was simply a breach of etiquette. Now , let's all put away our swords , put on a smile , and have a great convention![/q]
The BIN was never lowered. He was willing to sell it for less to that specific person who asked. The BIN never lowered.

item.comment: Do you work at the Carcassonne factory? 😄

Haha! When I get promos for my own personal Carcassonne collection, I usually get an extra copy or 2 because of shipping costs. They're absolutely brutal. All the Carcassonne stuff can be found on cundco.de, and they do ship to America, but it's usually not worth it to just get 1 or 2 things.
I'm a big Carcassonne fan but I haven't heard of half the stuff you post. Is there anything you don't have?

I've owned a lot of it. I have been selling some of it lately as Carcassonne just doesn't see the plays that it once did, plus, I had a lot of old stuff still in shrink. Sold a copy of [thing=85003][/thing] and [thing=167744][/thing] earlier this year. Those were by far the 2 most rare things that I had in the collection.
Very cool! I'm happy to have taken some of this off your hands for you, I'm excited to try them out. My wallet isn't too fond of you though. 😉
That looks interesting to play with. I'll BIN. Thanks!

Which is it?

[B]Version:[/B] [B]Language:[/B] [B]Condition:[/B] Good - [I]Frankenstein Edition - Read below [B]Bid closure:[/B] I will close bids 5pm (EST) Friday, June 28th. I will accept either PayPal, Venmo or Cash (Buyer covers fees if using Pay Pal or Venmo)
This starts with the first edition card set with the cards that were not reprinted in second edition removed.
This includes the Dominion: Update Pack sorted into the game
It does not include rules, you can download an encyclopedic version on BGG
The whole thing is then packed in a damaged 2nd edition box (see below)
So, in the end, what am I getting? Assuming you download the rules, a playable copy of Dominion with 2nd Edition card manifest but prettier first edition art on money and lands cards.
Why would I buy this?
- You really just want the Update Pack and will probably throw the rest away - You have played Dominion, like it enough to buy it, but don't want to pay MSRP for a 13 year old game - Your favorite nephew wants to borrow one of your games for a chicken wings and Cheetos party - You didn't read any of the above and are under the mistaken impression this is a retail version of 2nd Edition[/I]

item.body:
+altname+ McFarlane Walking Dead Building Sets -altname-
This is a almost complete collection of McFarlane's Waking Dead Building Set Collection (Like Legos) I have kept the sets on display for many years and kept every extra single bit in zip-locks. Its time to move these on to some one else too enjoy assembling and displaying. This collection is out of print as McFarlane lost the license many years ago to TWD (they reacquired it recently)
As shown in the images I have every single inventory and assembly book for every set i own including any figures purchased in blind bags. All of the components have been carefully disassembled and stored in the multitude of zip-locks shown and stored in a large box. So if your a walking dead collector this may be up your alley.
As a bonus i'm just throwing in there the Game of Thrones , Throne room and Standards sets.
Some of the sets like the truck and prison were over $100 new.
BIN: $150 This is a 'hope for' but absolutely not firm on this!!! Willing to hear offers.
Sold to: [user=JokerXL][/user]

item.comment: The Kickstarter also had a Mages expansion and Skellige expansion. Are those included here too? And what about the extra coins and dice?
Curious about those other things but I'll take it no matter what!

This does NOT include Mages or Skellige expansion and does not have extra coins or extra dice (but the normal dice that come with it are awesome!) If you would like to lock it in, please PayPal $220 to me "friends and family" using my email mmustafa06@gmail.com My cell is 973-907-6263, please text me your number so I can call and arrange for a smooth meetup next Thursday at 8AM! You will love this game, one of my favorites, (selling it since don't have the right group to play it with unfortunately...)

I have no doubt it's unintentional, but I would recommend against ever sending money via paypal friends and family in advance of a meet-up/in-person exchange. If someone is offering to BIN in the VFM (even in the late offer stage) that should be enough to have the item held and to allow them to complete payment at the exchange. Again, I have no doubt this is an the up and up sale, but it's best practice to never do a payment prior to an exchange that offers no buyer protections.

Thanks @mmustafa! I do want to lock it in and I'm excited to get the game! But it's not normal to pay ahead like you're asking. Please hold the game for me, and I'll be happy to Paypal, Zelle, or give cash when we meet. I'm happy to even wait around a few minutes so you can make sure the payment went through if it's digital. I guarantee we're good buyers and always follow through on purchases using the payment methods requested. We'll be at the Caribe starting Monday 7/1, and happy to even meet you beforehand. Please confirm the sale, and let me know when you'll be arriving. I can text you on whatever day you arrive to arrange the meetup. Thanks!

Thanks all, first time selling at this flea market and figured it was like selling on BGG marketplace where buyer pays and then you ship out (in this case hand deliver) game. Appreciate feedback and @Elise happy to mark as sold and lock it in now and I can take payment when I meet with you! Thanks!
That's great! Thank you so much! I'm a huge Witcher fan and very excited to finally have this!

item.comment:
$2, if you just want it to go to a home that will play it until it falls apart. 🙂
For anybody bored enough to read this ... I was taught to play rook by what is apparently a set of house rules, but didn't learn that until 20 years later. As far as I'm concerned, it is the only way to play Rook. "Rook-mid" -- the Rook is still worth 20 points, but it is considered a 10.5 trump. So, it beats a 10, but is beaten by an 11. Plus, last hand is worth 20 (so it is a possible 140 pt hand), 80-pt bid min, and winning team gets any points stored in the kitty.
